title: Autoresearch: drive PRF codec to dropout-benign KL at fixed 95% compression
step_target_note: Stage-2 prf-constant-incumbent measures s/step + peak mem; if a 40-step trial costs materially > ~3.5 GPU-hr, /monitor drops the horizon to 30 (every quantity of interest established by step 25-30).
money_gate: Stage-3 spend HALTS when remaining budget == ~8 GPU-hr Stage-4 reserve (winner-final-eval + winner-projection-off). At the gate: flag operator with the full trajectory + proposed next tranche, then proceed to Stage 4 on the reserve. Rejections NEVER end the loop (diagnose-and-propose).

cells.name: prf-constant-incumbent
cells.role: incumbent to beat + peak-memory event (two-circuit anchor clone past first refresh ~step 10; peak GPU mem < ~110GB)

stage3_note: OPEN-ENDED greedy loop, incumbent starts = prf-constant. Each candidate vs CURRENT incumbent at matched 40-step horizon. ACCEPT iff: actor/entropy reduced AND actor/kl_loss no higher AND actor/ppo_kl < ~1e-2 AND comm_eff/mask_ratio in [0.94,0.96] AND critic/score/mean early slope not degraded. KEEP=>new incumbent+stack; else discard+diagnose+propose next (seed queue first, then NEW flag-gated lever w/ off-path parity + test_activation_mask.py case + lint-clean prf-<lever> name BEFORE launch). Loop exits ONLY at the money gate. Levers wired: COMM_EFF_MASK_{RESCALE_MODE,EXACT_K,ANTITHETIC,P_BY_BOUNDARY}. Lever 3 (global keys) NOTE-ONLY (single-GPU no-op).

stage4_cells.name: winner-projection-off
stage4_cells.note: matched Stage-4 PAIR outside the greedy loop; full metric vector vs winner

expected_not_failure: rollout_probs_diff_mean ~0.95 on all PRF cells is EXPECTED (rollout uncompressed); never a stop trigger.
non_codec_surface: Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B; MATH parquet $HOME/data/math; train_batch 512; ppo_mini 256; n=8; prompt/response 1024/3072; lr 1e-6; kl_loss_coef 0.001; clip 0.2/0.2; anchor cadence/delay 20/20; beta_anc 0.25; signed_ema_alpha 0.25; anchor.lookahead_anchor=true throughout (ONLY exception: Stage-4 winner-projection-off).
success_criteria: all 4 stage gates evaluated (marked yes or no, none skipped)
incumbent trajectory emitted: accepted codec levers IN ORDER with justifying deltas per accepted lever vs prior incumbent
every candidate judged by the amended 5-part gate at matched 40-step horizon; comm_eff/mask_ratio in [0.94,0.96] on every ACCEPTED cell
final recommended PRF config shipped + ONE confirmation val (val-core/DigitalLearningGmbH/MATH-lighteval/acc/mean@1) vs dense-control
matched projection pair on the winner reported (lookahead_anchor true vs false) on the full metric vector; recommended config states which projection setting is favored
search loop exited ONLY at the money gate (or operator stop); every rejection has a recorded diagnose-and-propose entry
rollout_probs_diff_mean ~0.95 on all PRF cells recorded as EXPECTED
non-codec surface identical across all cells (the projection-off pair is the sole exception)
